teaser.en: A screw pine that stands on stilts beside creeks, with spiny leaves long enough to weave into mats.
teaser.sw: Mkadi unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili kando ya mikondo ya bahari, wenye majani yenye miiba marefu kiasi cha kusukwa mikeka.

summary.en: *Mkapu* is the name recorded for the Rabai screw pine, a tree up to 20 metres tall that stands on stilt roots along streams, creeks and swamps of the south coast. Like other screw pines its long leaves are used for weaving, and its fruits are said to be edible.
summary.sw: *Mkapu* ni jina lililorekodiwa kwa msanaka, mti unaofikia urefu wa mita 20 unaosimama juu ya mizizi-mihimili kando ya vijito, mikondo ya bahari na vinamasi vya pwani ya kusini. Kama mikadi mingine, majani yake marefu hutumika kusuka, na inasemekana matunda yake huliwa.

about.en:
The Rabai screw pine is the tall one of the coast's screw pines, reaching up to 20 metres. It is held up by stilt roots that prop the trunk above wet ground. The leaves are long and strap-like with spiny edges, and they grow in spirals around the branch tips, giving the tree its 'screw' look.

Despite the name, it is not a pine at all but a palm-like plant of the *Pandanus* family.
about.sw:
Msanaka ndio mrefu zaidi kati ya mikadi ya pwani, ukifikia hadi mita 20. Umeshikiliwa na mizizi-mihimili inayoliinua shina juu ya ardhi yenye maji. Majani yake ni marefu kama kanda yenye miiba pembeni, na hukua kwa mzunguko kama skrubu kuzunguka ncha za matawi, na hivyo kuupa mti sura yake ya 'skrubu'.

Ingawa jina lake la Kiingereza linauita msonobari (*pine*), si msonobari hata kidogo bali ni mmea unaofanana na mnazi wa familia ya *Pandanus*.

where.en: It grows along streams, near creeks and in swampy places on the south coast near Mombasa. Wherever the ground stays wet, look for its spiralled leaf crowns and stilt roots.
where.sw: Hukua kando ya vijito, karibu na mikondo ya bahari na katika sehemu za vinamasi katika pwani ya kusini karibu na Mombasa. Popote ardhi inapobaki na maji, tafuta vilele vyake vya majani yaliyozunguka kama skrubu na mizizi-mihimili yake.

uses.en: As with other screw pines, the leaves are used for weaving mats and baskets. The fruits are said to be edible.
uses.sw: Kama ilivyo kwa mikadi mingine, majani yake hutumika kusuka mikeka na vikapu. Inasemekana matunda yake huliwa.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mkapu*, under its entry for *Pandanus kirkii*. This name is doubtful: Pakia calls the screw pine *mkadi*, and both Pakia and the Mgombato dictionary use *kapu* or *mkapu* for the lemon. Other Mijikenda names are Duruma *mukurasa* and Giriama *mkaraza*. In Swahili it is *msanaka*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mkapu*, chini ya maelezo yake ya *Pandanus kirkii*. Jina hili lina shaka: Pakia anauita mkadi *mkadi*, na Pakia pamoja na kamusi ya Mgombato wanatumia *kapu* au *mkapu* kwa mlimau. Majina mengine ya Kimijikenda ni ya Kiduruma *mukurasa* na ya Kigiriama *mkaraza*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *msanaka*.

reason.en: The other screw pine, Pakia's mkadi
reason.sw: Mkadi mwingine, ule anaouita Pakia mkadi

reason.en: The lemon, which also goes by mkapu
Doum palm, another source of weaving leaves
reason.sw: Mkoma, chanzo kingine cha majani ya kusukia

reason.en: Raffia palm, also in wet ground
reason.sw: Mwale, pia hukua kwenye ardhi yenye maji
